Telegram bot starter scaffold: aiogram 3, Django 5, Celery; `/start` and tracking.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

`.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`/`DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` required; `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`. `main.py` initializes Django ORM, aiogram, middleware/routes, polling. `config/`: settings/database/Celery/admin. `bot/models.py`: `TelegramUser`; `bot/aiogram/handlers.py`: handlers; `bot/aiogram/middlewares.py`: tracking; `bot/tasks.py`: Celery. Add routers via `main.py:42`; models/admin in `bot/models.py`/`bot/admin.py`; tasks use `<REDACTED_USER>_task`; env vars in `.env.example`, access via `config/settings.py`. Redis required.
